caption: The drawing displays a small, rectangular, wall-mounted cupboard made of reddish-brown wood. The cupboard has a single door attached on the left side by two visible gold-colored hinges and features a small circular knob near the middle. A simple latch or lock is drawn on the right side of the door. The top of the cupboard has a decorative, rounded arch with a small hole in the center near the peak, possibly for hanging. The cupboard casts a gray shadow to its right and downward. Below the illustration, the words "Small hanging cupboard" are written in neat, gray text, and there are additional handwritten notes and numbers in the bottom corners. The background of the drawing is a plain, light cream color.
title: Shaker Hanging Cupboard
